summary: Verified fix for legacy /properties/all leak on 3 flows: (1) /stays AreaRow 'See all' header, (2) LikedTab 'Browse Properties' empty-state CTA, (3) PropertyDetail back-button default. All targeted flows now stay on the new unified /stays UI (stays-search-bar + stays-filters-btn) with the legacy properties-search-input never appearing.

critical_code_review_comments: Stays.jsx onSeeAll works via direct setWhere state update (comment explains why navigate() would strip the query due to no remount). This is functional but a bit surprising — consider adding a small util or hook to encapsulate this pattern if more callers need it.

LikedTab empty-state CTA could not be exercised end-to-end because the seeded renter@test.com already has likes. If empty-state coverage is important, either add a fixture that clears likes or add a second seeded user with an empty likes list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The unified /stays UI uses data-testid='stays-search-bar' (contains input with WHERE value) and 'stays-filters-btn'. Legacy Properties page has data-testid='properties-search-input' — its presence anywhere in the /stays flow is a regression. Area 'See all' testids follow pattern 'stays-see-all-{area name}' e.g. 'stays-see-all-Jerusalem - American Colony'. Stays cards use 'stays-card-{uuid}'. PropertyDetail back button is data-testid='back-button' with label 'Back to listings'.
rca of the issue: Root cause of original bug: AreaRow 'See all' was calling navigate('/properties/all?area=X'), landing on the legacy Properties page which has its own filter UI (properties-search-input). Similar hardcoded '/properties/all' routes existed in LikedTab and PropertyDetail's back-fallback. Fix: (1) Stays.jsx onSeeAll now calls setWhere(area) directly instead of navigate — because /stays->/stays w/ different query doesn't remount, so a navigate would leave state stale and syncUrl would wipe the area param. Setting state triggers syncUrl to write ?area=X and grouped view collapses to filtered flat grid. (2) LikedTab and PropertyDetail fallbacks now point to /stays. All three flows verified end-to-end via Playwright + one via code inspection.
